topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it. After all these months, I find out she's just a few blocks away. I've been talking to her every day, and we've shared so much, yet I never even considered the chance we could be neighbors. Now that I know, I can't stop thinking about it. I've got to do something, but what? I don't want to scare her off, but I also can't just let this unbelievable coincidence slip away. What if I mess this up? What if I've been building this up in my head and it’s not what I think it is? I need to figure out how to turn this online connection into something real, but the stakes feel so high.
